title: Coding agents install packages into the person's own environment without saying so
body:
During `chat send "Fix the bug in calc.py … Run the tests with python3 -m pytest -q"` (full access, Codex), the agent ran `python3 -m pip install --user pytest` — a change outside the task worktree to the user's Python — and the turn summary only says "1 file changed". Either keep installs inside the task (a venv in the worktree / cache), or list changes made outside the worktree in the turn summary so the person knows.

Found in the code shakeout (scratch repo ~/work/shakeout/scratch-code, binary built at eeae76ff5a).
